provenance.purpose: deterministic observation-window, censoring, knowledge-time, and grouped-resampling contract checks

time_contract.event_at_start: included if observed and available by the applicable cutoff
time_contract.event_at_end: excluded from the window and administratively right-censored at end

time_fields.event_time: when the underlying event occurred; may be unavailable to a historical training view
time_fields.available_at: when the value became available to the model or analyst
time_fields.recorded_at: when the source recorded the value; recording can be delayed

time_contract.training_feature_rule: A feature is usable at cutoff only if available_at <= cutoff; event_time alone does not establish historical availability.

FX-001.purpose: observed event count and follow-up retain right censoring
FX-001.limits: Fixture accounting only; no distribution or estimator is selected and no fit is performed.

FX-014.purpose: training cutoff censors later completion and blocks future-known features

FX-003.purpose: day cluster resampling preserves shared-day uncertainty

split_policies.day_block: Keep each chronological day wholly in one partition; primary split/resampling unit for this fixture.
split_policies.patient_group: When patient IDs repeat and do not cross the requested partition boundary, keep each patient wholly in one partition as a separate explicit policy.
split_policies.crossed_groups: If patient IDs cross chronological days, simultaneous patient and day exclusivity can constrain or prevent a requested split; report the crossed groups and require a declared policy instead of silently demanding both.

crossed_group_case.constraint: Keeping each day intact forces cross-1 with cross-2; keeping each patient intact also binds cross-3 through day-b, so the requested split cannot separate these groups.

ambiguous_status.purpose: preserve ambiguous event-versus-censor state without coercion

limits: All values and identifiers are synthetic; no real ED values or patient data are present.
This fixture specifies observation and split semantics only; fitting, estimator selection, empirical thresholds, and candidate decisions remain for P3.2.
The day-block and patient-group rules are distinct policies. Crossed groups require an explicit policy and are not silently treated as nested.
The FX-003 variance values are hand-calculated fixture expectations, not empirical uncertainty estimates.
Source-linked examples are synthetic fixture extensions; lineage does not promote them to empirical ED evidence.

synthetic_fixture_extensions.half_open_classification: The executable classifier below uses [start,end): start is included and end excluded.
synthetic_fixture_extensions.cutoff_feature_filtering: The executable feature selector includes only records with available_at <= cutoff.
synthetic_fixture_extensions.group_split_membership: The day-block and patient-group train/holdout membership lists are synthetic fixtures and are checked for disjointness.
synthetic_fixture_extensions.ambiguous_status: Ambiguous event/censor status remains unresolved; no event or censor flag is inferred.
